description: She wears a floor-length plum-purple layered gown with a high square neckline, opaque fitted inner sleeves and draped outer sleeves. Broad gold woven floral borders run along the neckline, cuffs, vertical panels and hem. Two round jeweled shoulder clasps and a gold belt with oval red stones ornament the gown. A cream inner skirt shows between the purple front panels, with brown closed shoes beneath the hem. A small purple pendant hangs at her upper chest.
